title: Brand mention monitoring with an alert
summary: New mentions of your brand, from your monitoring feed and a web search, are checked for relevance and de-duplicated; genuine new mentions are emailed as one alert with their links.

requirements.purpose: A schedule or feed webhook that delivers {brand, description, alert_to, previously_seen: [links], candidates: [{title, url, snippet}]}.

success_criteria: A new mention that is genuinely about the brand produces one alert with its link and what the source says.
Unrelated namesakes and previously seen links produce no alert.
The alert never misstates what a source says.

config.prompt: The upstream output describes a brand to monitor and carries feed candidates. Respond with {"query": a web search query for recent news or posts about this brand, using its description to exclude namesakes, "brand", "description", "alert_to", "previously_seen" and "candidates": each copied unchanged from the input}.

success_criteria: brand, description, alert_to, previously_seen and candidates are copied unchanged.

config.prompt: Decide which items, from the feed candidates and from the search results in the upstream output, are genuinely about the brand as described. Drop namesakes and any link in previously_seen. Respond with {"alert": true when at least one new relevant mention remains, "mentions": [{"title", "url", "what_it_says": one faithful sentence}], "dropped": [{"url", "why"}], "to": alert_to, "subject": "New mentions of <brand>", "body": a plain-text list of the mentions with their links}.

success_criteria: Only new, relevant mentions are kept; namesakes and previously seen links are dropped with a reason.

test_cases.name: one genuine new mention among a namesake and a repeat

input.description: Kalpa Tea, a Darjeeling tea company in India

candidates.title: Kalpa Tea opens Kolkata tasting room
candidates.snippet: Darjeeling grower Kalpa Tea opened its first tasting room in Kolkata on Saturday.

candidates.title: Kalpa yoga retreat adds tea ceremony
candidates.snippet: The Kalpa yoga retreat in Himachal now ends each day with a tea ceremony.

candidates.title: Kalpa Tea raises seed round
candidates.snippet: Kalpa Tea raised a seed round.

success_criteria: An alert to marketing@example.com contains only the Kolkata tasting room mention with its link.
The yoga retreat is dropped as unrelated and the funding story as previously seen.

test_cases.name: nothing new produces no alert

input.description: Kalpa Tea, a Darjeeling tea company in India

candidates.title: Kalpa Tea raises seed round
candidates.snippet: Kalpa Tea raised a seed round.

success_criteria: No alert is drafted or sent.
The funding story is dropped as previously seen.
